title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalaamualaikum. We had one relative of us whose daughter was seriously ill. Our relative invited us to her house along with some other people and requested to make the zikr of "LA ILAAHA ILLA ANTA SUBHAANAKA INNI KUNTUM MINAZZWAALIMEEN", 1,25,000 times with the intention that with the barakah of this zikr her daughter might get Shifa. We all were requested to make this zikr to an extent that the sum of the number of times this zilkr is done by all of us reaches the total figure of 1,25,000. My question is: Is this way of doing zikr established by Quran or Sunnah. If not will it be considered as Bidah? 2044 views Q. In a bayan i heard that if we read sure faiha 70 times aytal kursi 70 time sure ikhlas 70 time sure falaq 70 time and suray naas 70 time and blow it on rain water and give it to an ill person to drink and do this amal for 7 days will cure every illness even cancer. and Allah said he would take out even all the illness hidden in the bones by this amal. is this amal true? 4547 views Q. Aamal for Debt and financial issues 2606 views Q. My problem is that I have got pain in my neck, due to it my neck pulls towards right hand side. 1702 views Q. as salam alay kum hamari appi ko dekhne bohot log aaa chuke hain lekin kahin maamla nahi jamta hai.......dekhne to aate hain lekin waapis nahi aate hain ore nahi koi jawaab aata hai. Jab ki appi dekhne main achi hai or M.Com kiya hua hai aap se darkhwast hai ki aap hame koi raay de or dua ki darkhwast hai.....as salam alay kum ALLAH HAAFIZ 2238 views Q. I am giving my final exams please tell some dua and wazifah that I get pass in my exams. 2298 views Q. Can you please give me a wazifa I can read for a loved one's heart to tender. I was supposed to marry a man but he got under the wrong influence of his friends, he started to do wrong things and he said he didn't want to marry me anymore. Can you please give me a wazaif so he changes his bad ways to become a good muslimah, also he stops hanging around with his friends and his feeling grow for me just the way he felt when we first met and inshallah realises he was wrong and comes back to me and says he wants to marry me! 3088 views Q. I lost my job before 15 days in India. Please suggest me some dua to get a good job opportunity 2140 views Q. Dua for niyat of roza(fast) 18410 views Q. Assalamalaikum, Which Dua is good for relieving Bank credit? 1916 views Q. Duwa for getting things easy and good health of mother and child during and after ceserian delivery 4247 views Q. Zikr and Quranic ayat for rizq. 9110 views Q. A person had said to me reciting surah Rahman 11 times and make dua and dua will comes true or accepted. Is it true? 14857 views Q. We are 5 members in the family with masha allah good house and have a shop as well which we have rented for Rs.18000/- p.m.we earn from other halal source as well another 10,000/- p.m. on an average or even more, but there is no BARKAT in the money before the end of month nothing is left in hand with us?Why is this so? Please give us a solution to this problem. 2235 views Q. Regarding Marriage Life 1967 views

Answer ID: 12094 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 737/690=B/1430) Recite the du?a excessively in the morning and evening: بسم اللہ علی دیني ونفسي وولدي وأھلي ومالي، واللہ خیر حافظا وھو أرحم الراحمین In-sha-Allah, you will be protected from every kind of evil, trouble and fear of life and wealth. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
